description: This file contains PHP functions related to SOAP web services for SuiteCRM, including data retrieval, relationship management, session and access checks, data formatting, and utility functions for encryption, file handling, and version comparison.

classes.name: SugarBean
classes.description: A placeholder for the SugarBean class, representing CRM data objects.

methods.name: get_field_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of fields and their metadata for a given SugarBean object.

methods.name: new_get_field_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of module fields and link fields for a given SugarBean object.

methods.name: setFaultObject
methods.description: Sets a fault response in the SOAP server with an error object.

methods.name: checkSessionAndModuleAccess
methods.description: Validates session and module access permissions for a user.

methods.name: checkACLAccess
methods.description: Checks access control list permissions for a bean and view type.

methods.name: get_name_value
methods.description: Returns an array with name and value keys.

methods.name: get_user_module_list
methods.description: Returns a list of modules accessible to a user.

methods.name: check_modules_access
methods.description: Checks if a user has access to a specific module and action.

methods.name: get_name_value_list
methods.description: Generates a list of name-value pairs for a given object.

methods.name: array_get_name_value_list
methods.description: Converts an array into a list of name-value pairs.

methods.name: array_get_name_value_lists
methods.description: Converts an array into a list of name-value pairs, handling nested arrays.

methods.name: name_value_lists_get_array
methods.description: Converts a list of name-value pairs back into an associative array.

methods.name: array_get_return_value
methods.description: Formats an array into a standard return structure with module info.

methods.name: get_return_value_for_fields
methods.description: Generates a return structure for a bean with specific fields.

methods.name: getRelationshipResults
methods.description: Retrieves related records for a bean via a relationship link.

methods.name: get_return_value_for_link_fields
methods.description: Generates return data for linked records of a bean.

methods.name: new_handle_set_relationship
methods.description: Creates relationships between modules and records.

methods.name: new_handle_set_entries
methods.description: Creates or updates multiple records in a module based on provided data.

methods.name: get_return_value
methods.description: Generates a standard return structure for a bean.

methods.name: get_encoded_Value
methods.description: Encodes a value into an XML-safe format.

methods.name: get_name_value_xml
methods.description: Generates XML representation of a name-value list.

methods.name: new_get_return_module_fields
methods.description: Returns module fields and link fields for a bean.

methods.name: get_return_module_fields
methods.description: Returns module fields and an error list for a bean.

methods.name: get_return_error_value
methods.description: Creates an error value structure.

methods.name: filter_field_list
methods.description: Filters a list of fields based on validity and access.

methods.name: filter_return_list
methods.description: Filters a list of output data to include only selected fields.

methods.name: login_success
methods.description: Initializes language and string settings after login.

methods.name: add_create_account
methods.description: Creates or associates an account with a contact record.

methods.name: check_for_duplicate_contacts
methods.description: Checks for duplicate contact records based on email and name.

methods.name: is_server_version_greater
methods.description: Compares two version arrays to determine if the server version is greater or equal.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Extracts a file from a ZIP archive to a temporary directory.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Retrieves the manifest.php file from a ZIP archive.

methods.name: get_encoded
methods.description: Serializes and base64 encodes an object.

methods.name: get_decoded
methods.description: Decodes and unserializes a base64-encoded string.

methods.name: decrypt_string
methods.description: Decrypts a string using TripleDES if available.

methods.name: canViewPath
methods.description: Checks if a path is within a base directory.

methods.name: apply_values
methods.description: Applies data values to a SugarBean object, optionally only on first sync.
